learned: 2026-10-17: a Squarespace page /coas of ~65 PDF links (/s/<file>.pdf), grouped under strain headings, link text 'lot #<lot>'. One link is a Keystone labware portal (HTML, not a PDF) and one is a packaging-ink COA (skipped).
notes: Filenames abbreviate the strain: SG Silly Goofy, PNC, LB, SCK, REV Revelation, PP Pillow Princess, HH. Only some filenames spell it out (Silly-Goofy-..., Pillow-Princess-Lot-...); otherwise the strain comes from the report itself.
Lot forms: 010010001 (single) / 020010002 (5-pack), FPR25003 (pre-roll), FMPR25003 (mini pre-roll 5-pack), SCK-PR26004, FFA26005, CR-HF-FL-RV-1 (flower).
